title: The Blacksmith’s Hairpin
subtitle: Wet steps, bellows & the forge
text: A blacksmith's apprentice accidentally snapped a bride's hairpin, with barely enough time left before the wedding procession. Clutching its box, he ran down the stone street, his shoes splashing through muddy water. Inside the forge, the bellows pumped steadily and the fire crackled higher. His master told him to slow down. He straightened the ornament with small, ringing hammer taps, wound the silver wire back into place, and closed the pliers with a sharp click. Wedding drums drew nearer from the street. He polished the hairpin and returned it before the bridal sedan stopped at the door.
